scope: Additive recheck of Air Sweeper mechanics; records conflicting public geometry without enabling a proxy.
game_version: Official aimed-defense evidence and a version-unknown secondary mechanics page reconsulted on 2026-09-20.

sources.title: The Town Hall 17 Update Is Here!
sources.limitations: Still establishes only an aimed direction and coverage cone, not angle, vector, blast path, collision or fixed-tick order.

sources.title: Air Sweeper
sources.limitations: The same current page reports incompatible 10-, 30-, 60-, 90- and 120-degree descriptions. It also says displacement is normal to an unspecified curved blast, while publishing no origin, curve, hit boundary, collision, target order or version-pinned replay.

known_uncertainties: The recheck adds no compatible numerical geometry: its angle and coverage descriptions cannot be mapped to one deterministic effect sector.
No public source fixes the blast curve/origin, resulting vector, collision clipping, simultaneous-target order, action interruption or snapshot/replay state.
conclusion: The 20 September recheck confirms Air Sweeper must remain data-only. Its exact catalogue values are retained, but an aimed pushback model would still invent decisive geometry and ordering rules.
